-- | Closed field identities for the private observation profile.
--
-- Each 'Field' fixes its row and value types. Its descriptor supplies the
-- tmux variable, 'WireType' and pure 'project' operation together; transport
-- and local evaluation must not define independent field mappings.
-- 'decodeField' consumes already unescaped bytes, without trimming or IO.
module LibTmux.Internal.Field
  ( Field (..), SomeField (..), catalogue, WireType (..), FieldError (..), FieldFailure (..)
  , fieldKey, formatVariable, wireType, minimumTmux, project, decodeField
  ) where

import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import Data.ByteString qualified as Bytes
import Data.ByteString.Char8 qualified as Ascii
import Data.Text (Text)
import Data.Text qualified as Text
import Data.Text.Encoding qualified as Utf8
import Foreign.C.Types (CInt)
import LibTmux.Id qualified as Id
import LibTmux.Internal.Graph qualified as G
import LibTmux.Internal.TmuxText qualified as Label
import LibTmux.Value qualified as V
import LibTmux.Version qualified as Version
import System.OsPath.Posix (PosixPath)
import System.OsString.Posix (PosixString)
import System.OsString.Posix qualified as Os

-- | Fields belong to physical rows or contextual links, never both implicitly.
data Field row value where
  ServerPid :: Field G.ServerInfo Integer
  ServerStartedAt :: Field G.ServerInfo Integer
  ServerVersion :: Field G.ServerInfo Version.TmuxVersion
  ServerSocketPath :: Field G.ServerInfo PosixPath
  ClientName :: Field G.Client PosixString
  ClientPid :: Field G.Client Integer
  ClientTty :: Field G.Client (Maybe PosixPath)
  ClientWidth :: Field G.Client Integer
  ClientHeight :: Field G.Client (Maybe Integer)
  ClientSession :: Field G.ClientAttachment Id.SessionId
  ClientWindow :: Field G.ClientAttachment Id.WindowId
  ClientWindowIndex :: Field G.ClientAttachment V.WindowIndex
  ClientPane :: Field G.ClientAttachment Id.PaneId
  SessionId :: Field G.Session Id.SessionId
  SessionName :: Field G.Session Text
  SessionAttached :: Field G.Session Integer
  SessionGroup :: Field G.Session (Maybe Label.TmuxText)
  WindowId :: Field G.Window Id.WindowId
  WindowName :: Field G.Window Label.TmuxText
  WindowWidth :: Field G.Window V.Dimension
  WindowHeight :: Field G.Window V.Dimension
  WindowLayout :: Field G.Window Text
  WindowZoomed :: Field G.Window Bool
  PaneId :: Field G.Pane Id.PaneId
  PaneWindow :: Field G.Pane Id.WindowId
  PaneIndex :: Field G.Pane V.PaneIndex
  PaneWidth :: Field G.Pane V.Dimension
  PaneHeight :: Field G.Pane V.Dimension
  PaneActive :: Field G.Pane Bool
  PaneDead :: Field G.Pane Bool
  PaneTitle :: Field G.Pane Text
  PaneCommand :: Field G.Pane PosixString
  PanePath :: Field G.Pane PosixPath
  PaneCursorX :: Field G.Pane Integer
  PaneCursorY :: Field G.Pane Integer
  PaneModeCount :: Field G.Pane Integer
  PaneMode :: Field G.Pane (Maybe Text)
  LinkSession :: Field G.WindowLink Id.SessionId
  LinkWindow :: Field G.WindowLink Id.WindowId
  LinkIndex :: Field G.WindowLink V.WindowIndex
  LinkActive :: Field G.WindowLink Bool
  LinkFlags :: Field G.WindowLink Text

-- | The finite native catalogue, without erasing each descriptor's evidence.
data SomeField where
  SomeField :: Field row value -> SomeField

catalogue :: [SomeField]
catalogue =
  [ SomeField ServerPid, SomeField ServerStartedAt, SomeField ServerVersion, SomeField ServerSocketPath
  , SomeField ClientName, SomeField ClientPid, SomeField ClientTty, SomeField ClientWidth, SomeField ClientHeight
  , SomeField ClientSession, SomeField ClientWindow, SomeField ClientWindowIndex, SomeField ClientPane
  , SomeField SessionId, SomeField SessionName, SomeField SessionAttached, SomeField SessionGroup
  , SomeField WindowId, SomeField WindowName, SomeField WindowWidth, SomeField WindowHeight
  , SomeField WindowLayout, SomeField WindowZoomed
  , SomeField PaneId, SomeField PaneWindow, SomeField PaneIndex, SomeField PaneWidth, SomeField PaneHeight
  , SomeField PaneActive, SomeField PaneDead, SomeField PaneTitle, SomeField PaneCommand, SomeField PanePath
  , SomeField PaneCursorX, SomeField PaneCursorY, SomeField PaneModeCount, SomeField PaneMode
  , SomeField LinkSession, SomeField LinkWindow, SomeField LinkIndex, SomeField LinkActive, SomeField LinkFlags
  ]

-- | Checked wire domains. POSIX path and string share a representation but
-- retain different descriptors; neither promises local filesystem semantics.
data WireType value where
  SessionIdValue :: WireType Id.SessionId
  WindowIdValue :: WireType Id.WindowId
  PaneIdValue :: WireType Id.PaneId
  TextValue :: WireType Text
  NonEmptyTextValue :: WireType Text
  OptionalTextValue :: WireType (Maybe Text)
  OptionalLabelValue :: WireType (Maybe Label.TmuxText)
  LabelValue :: WireType Label.TmuxText
  PosixStringValue :: WireType PosixString
  PosixPathValue :: WireType PosixPath
  NonEmptyPosixStringValue :: WireType PosixString
  NonEmptyPosixPathValue :: WireType PosixPath
  OptionalPosixPathValue :: WireType (Maybe PosixPath)
  ProcessIdValue :: WireType Integer
  EpochSecondsValue :: WireType Integer
  VersionValue :: WireType Version.TmuxVersion
  DimensionValue :: WireType V.Dimension
  PaneIndexValue :: WireType V.PaneIndex
  WindowIndexValue :: WireType V.WindowIndex
  UnsignedValue :: WireType Integer
  OptionalUnsignedValue :: WireType (Maybe Integer)
  BooleanValue :: WireType Bool

data Descriptor row value = Descriptor !Text !ByteString !(WireType value) !(row -> value)

descriptor :: Field row value -> Descriptor row value
descriptor = \case
  ServerPid -> Descriptor "server.pid" "pid" ProcessIdValue (.pid)
  ServerStartedAt -> Descriptor "server.startedAt" "start_time" EpochSecondsValue (.startedAt)
  ServerVersion -> Descriptor "server.version" "version" VersionValue (.version)
  ServerSocketPath -> Descriptor "server.socketPath" "socket_path" NonEmptyPosixPathValue (.socketPath)
  ClientName -> Descriptor "client.name" "client_name" NonEmptyPosixStringValue (.name)
  ClientPid -> Descriptor "client.pid" "client_pid" ProcessIdValue (.pid)
  ClientTty -> Descriptor "client.tty" "client_tty" OptionalPosixPathValue (.tty)
  ClientWidth -> Descriptor "client.width" "client_width" UnsignedValue (.width)
  ClientHeight -> Descriptor "client.height" "client_height" OptionalUnsignedValue (.height)
  ClientSession -> Descriptor "client.session" "session_id" SessionIdValue (\row -> sessionId row.session.ref)
  ClientWindow -> Descriptor "client.window" "window_id" WindowIdValue (\row -> windowId row.window.ref)
  ClientWindowIndex -> Descriptor "client.windowIndex" "window_index" WindowIndexValue (\row -> row.pane.link.index)
  ClientPane -> Descriptor "client.pane" "pane_id" PaneIdValue (\row -> paneId row.pane.pane.ref)
  SessionId -> Descriptor "session.id" "session_id" SessionIdValue (sessionId . (.ref))
  SessionName -> Descriptor "session.name" "session_name" TextValue (.name)
  SessionAttached -> Descriptor "session.attached" "session_attached" UnsignedValue (.attached)
  SessionGroup -> Descriptor "session.group" "session_group" OptionalLabelValue (.group)
  WindowId -> Descriptor "window.id" "window_id" WindowIdValue (windowId . (.ref))
  WindowName -> Descriptor "window.name" "window_name" LabelValue (.name)
  WindowWidth -> Descriptor "window.width" "window_width" DimensionValue (.width)
  WindowHeight -> Descriptor "window.height" "window_height" DimensionValue (.height)
  WindowLayout -> Descriptor "window.layout" "window_layout" NonEmptyTextValue (.layout)
  WindowZoomed -> Descriptor "window.zoomed" "window_zoomed_flag" BooleanValue (.zoomed)
  PaneId -> Descriptor "pane.id" "pane_id" PaneIdValue (paneId . (.ref))
  PaneWindow -> Descriptor "pane.window" "window_id" WindowIdValue (windowId . (.window))
  PaneIndex -> Descriptor "pane.index" "pane_index" PaneIndexValue (.index)
  PaneWidth -> Descriptor "pane.width" "pane_width" DimensionValue (.width)
  PaneHeight -> Descriptor "pane.height" "pane_height" DimensionValue (.height)
  PaneActive -> Descriptor "pane.active" "pane_active" BooleanValue (.active)
  PaneDead -> Descriptor "pane.dead" "pane_dead" BooleanValue (.dead)
  PaneTitle -> Descriptor "pane.title" "pane_title" TextValue (.title)
  PaneCommand -> Descriptor "pane.currentCommand" "pane_current_command" PosixStringValue (.currentCommand)
  PanePath -> Descriptor "pane.currentPath" "pane_current_path" PosixPathValue (.currentPath)
  PaneCursorX -> Descriptor "pane.cursorX" "cursor_x" UnsignedValue (.cursorX)
  PaneCursorY -> Descriptor "pane.cursorY" "cursor_y" UnsignedValue (.cursorY)
  PaneModeCount -> Descriptor "pane.modeCount" "pane_in_mode" UnsignedValue (.modeCount)
  PaneMode -> Descriptor "pane.mode" "pane_mode" OptionalTextValue (.mode)
  LinkSession -> Descriptor "windowLink.session" "session_id" SessionIdValue (sessionId . (.session))
  LinkWindow -> Descriptor "windowLink.window" "window_id" WindowIdValue (windowId . (.window))
  LinkIndex -> Descriptor "windowLink.index" "window_index" WindowIndexValue (.index)
  LinkActive -> Descriptor "windowLink.active" "window_active" BooleanValue (.active)
  LinkFlags -> Descriptor "windowLink.flags" "window_flags" TextValue (.flags)

sessionId :: G.SessionRef -> Id.SessionId
sessionId (G.SessionRef _ ident) = ident

windowId :: G.WindowRef -> Id.WindowId
windowId (G.WindowRef _ ident) = ident

paneId :: G.PaneRef -> Id.PaneId
paneId (G.PaneRef _ ident) = ident

-- | Stable model-qualified key; independent of the Haskell constructor name.
fieldKey :: Field row value -> Text
fieldKey field = case descriptor field of Descriptor key _ _ _ -> key

-- | Trusted tmux variable name, without format delimiters or caller input.
formatVariable :: Field row value -> ByteString
formatVariable field = case descriptor field of Descriptor _ variable _ _ -> variable

-- | Type evidence for scalar decoding and typed query interpretation.
wireType :: Field row value -> WireType value
wireType field = case descriptor field of Descriptor _ _ valueType _ -> valueType

-- | Minimum qualified profile, not the release that introduced each variable.
-- Every field in this finite profile is available at the tmux 3.3a floor.
minimumTmux :: Field row value -> Text
minimumTmux _ = "3.3a"

-- | Read an owned observation. This never navigates a graph or contacts tmux.
project :: Field row value -> row -> value
project field = case descriptor field of Descriptor _ _ _ get -> get

-- | A bounded diagnostic identifies the field without retaining its input.
data FieldError = FieldError !Text !FieldFailure
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)

data FieldFailure = InvalidSyntax | InvalidEncoding | UnexpectedNul | ValueTooLarge !Int
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)

-- | Validate decoded scalar bytes, retaining exact byte-bearing values.
-- One MiB is the scalar payload ceiling. Numeric ranges follow tmux
-- storage domains; the public mathematical newtypes have separate constructors.
decodeField :: Field row value -> ByteString -> Either FieldError value
decodeField field bytes
  | Bytes.length bytes > 1048576 = failure (ValueTooLarge (Bytes.length bytes))
  | Bytes.elem 0 bytes = failure UnexpectedNul
  | otherwise = either failure Right (decodeValue (wireType field) bytes)
  where
    failure = Left . FieldError (fieldKey field)

decodeValue :: WireType value -> ByteString -> Either FieldFailure value
decodeValue valueType bytes = case valueType of
  SessionIdValue -> ident Id.parseSessionId
  WindowIdValue -> ident Id.parseWindowId
  PaneIdValue -> ident Id.parsePaneId
  TextValue -> text
  NonEmptyTextValue -> if Bytes.null bytes then Left InvalidSyntax else text
  OptionalTextValue -> if Bytes.null bytes then Right Nothing else Just <$> text
  OptionalLabelValue -> Right (if Bytes.null bytes then Nothing else Just (Label.fromBytes bytes))
  LabelValue -> Right (Label.fromBytes bytes)
  PosixStringValue -> Right (Os.fromBytestring bytes)
  PosixPathValue -> Right (Os.fromBytestring bytes)
  NonEmptyPosixStringValue -> if Bytes.null bytes then Left InvalidSyntax else Right (Os.fromBytestring bytes)
  NonEmptyPosixPathValue -> if Bytes.null bytes then Left InvalidSyntax else Right (Os.fromBytestring bytes)
  OptionalPosixPathValue -> Right (if Bytes.null bytes then Nothing else Just (Os.fromBytestring bytes))
  ProcessIdValue -> do
    value <- natural (toInteger (maxBound @CInt))
    if value > 0 then Right value else Left InvalidSyntax
  EpochSecondsValue -> number 19 9223372036854775807
  VersionValue -> either (const (Left InvalidSyntax)) Right
    (Version.parseVersion (Utf8.decodeLatin1 bytes) >>= Version.requireSupported)
  DimensionValue -> natural 4294967295 >>= checked V.mkDimension
  PaneIndexValue -> natural 4294967295 >>= checked V.mkPaneIndex
  WindowIndexValue -> natural 2147483647 >>= checked V.mkWindowIndex
  UnsignedValue -> natural 4294967295
  OptionalUnsignedValue -> if Bytes.null bytes then Right Nothing else Just <$> natural 4294967295
  BooleanValue -> case bytes of
    "0" -> Right False
    "1" -> Right True
    _ -> Left InvalidSyntax
  where
    text = either (const (Left InvalidEncoding)) (Right . Text.copy) (Utf8.decodeUtf8' bytes)
    ident :: (Text -> Either error value) -> Either FieldFailure value
    ident parse
      | Bytes.length bytes > 11 = Left InvalidSyntax
      | otherwise = either (const (Left InvalidSyntax)) Right (parse (Utf8.decodeLatin1 bytes))
    natural :: Integer -> Either FieldFailure Integer
    natural = number 10
    number :: Int -> Integer -> Either FieldFailure Integer
    number digits upper
      | Bytes.null bytes || Bytes.length bytes > digits
        || not (Bytes.all (\byte -> byte >= 48 && byte <= 57) bytes) = Left InvalidSyntax
      | otherwise = case Ascii.readInteger bytes of
          Just (value, "") | value <= upper -> Right value
          _ -> Left InvalidSyntax
    checked :: (Integer -> Either error value) -> Integer -> Either FieldFailure value
    checked build = either (const (Left InvalidSyntax)) Right . build

internal/LibTmux/Internal/Graph.hs.content:
-- | Detached physical entities, contextual links and validated graph indexes.
--
-- Window and session-group labels use 'TmuxText'; process names and paths
-- preserve POSIX bytes.
-- Reading an observation or navigating the graph performs no IO.
-- 'assembleEntityGraph' validates references, unique positions and selections
-- for its ordered views and lookup indexes. 'assembleSnapshot' joins
-- metadata and attached clients, then forces the complete detached value.
module LibTmux.Internal.Graph
  ( EndpointIdentity (..), Generation (..)
  , SessionRef (..), WindowRef (..), PaneRef (..), CreatedEntities (..), CreatedSession
  , Session (..), Window (..), Pane (..), WindowLink (..), PaneOccurrence (..)
  , EntityGraph, GraphError (..), LookupError (..), assembleEntityGraph
  , graphSessions, graphWindows, graphPanes, graphLinks, graphOccurrences
  , lookupSession, lookupWindow, lookupPane, linksForSession, panesForWindow
  , ServerInfo (..), Client (..), ClientAttachment (..), ClientInput (..)
  , Snapshot, serverInfo, entities, clients, assembleSnapshot
  , CaptureInterval (..), captureInterval, stampSnapshot
  ) where

import Control.Monad (foldM, unless, void, when)
import Data.Bifunctor (first)
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import Data.ByteString qualified as Bytes
import Data.List (sortOn)
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import Data.Map.Strict qualified as Map
import Data.Set qualified as Set
import Data.Text (Text)
import Data.Word (Word64)

data EndpointIdentity = EndpointIdentity !Integer !Integer
  deriving stock (Eq, Ord, Show)
instance NFData EndpointIdentity where
  rnf (EndpointIdentity device inode) = rnf device `seq` rnf inode

-- | Opaque connection or offline-fixture identity. Independent Server handles
-- receive distinct tokens; named fixtures never equal an adopted endpoint.
data Generation = Generation !EndpointIdentity !ByteString
  | FixtureGeneration !Text
  deriving stock (Eq, Ord, Show)
instance NFData Generation where
  rnf (Generation endpoint token) = rnf endpoint `seq` rnf token
  rnf (FixtureGeneration name) = rnf name

-- | Session targeting identity within a t'Generation'. Compare observations
-- separately when their captured field values matter.
data SessionRef = SessionRef !Generation !SessionId
  deriving stock (Eq, Ord, Show)
instance NFData SessionRef where
  rnf (SessionRef generation ident) = rnf generation `seq` rnf ident

-- | Physical window targeting identity within a t'Generation'. A window can
-- have several t'WindowLink' appearances.
data WindowRef = WindowRef !Generation !WindowId
  deriving stock (Eq, Ord, Show)
instance NFData WindowRef where
  rnf (WindowRef generation ident) = rnf generation `seq` rnf ident

-- | Physical pane targeting identity within a t'Generation'. This carries
-- identity, while the supplied t'Snapshot' determines the observed values.
data PaneRef = PaneRef !Generation !PaneId
  deriving stock (Eq, Ord, Show)
instance NFData PaneRef where
  rnf (PaneRef generation ident) = rnf generation `seq` rnf ident

-- | Historical identities printed during session, window or pane creation. A later hook
-- may already have removed them. Resolve through a fresh captured snapshot;
-- these references do not constitute hydrated observations or prove liveness.
-- Read these fields with record dot; construction remains private.
--
-- [#v:serverPid# @serverPid@ :: 'Integer'] Daemon PID printed with the receipt.
-- [#v:session# @session@ :: t'SessionRef'] Session containing the creation.
-- [#v:window# @window@ :: t'WindowRef'] Physical window containing the new pane.
-- [#v:pane# @pane@ :: t'PaneRef'] Created physical pane.
-- [#v:windowIndex# @windowIndex@ :: t'WindowIndex'] Link index printed by tmux.
data CreatedEntities = CreatedEntities
  { serverPid :: !Integer -- ^ Daemon PID printed with the creation receipt.
  , session :: !SessionRef -- ^ Session containing the new pane in the originating generation.
  , window :: !WindowRef -- ^ Physical window containing the new pane.
  , pane :: !PaneRef -- ^ Actual created physical pane.
  , windowIndex :: !WindowIndex -- ^ Link index printed by tmux before after-hooks.
  } deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData CreatedEntities where
  rnf (CreatedEntities pid session window pane index) =
    rnf pid `seq` rnf session `seq` rnf window `seq` rnf pane `seq` rnf index

-- | A 'CreatedEntities' receipt from new-session: all three entities are new.
type CreatedSession = CreatedEntities

-- | Detached physical session. Navigate its appearances through t'WindowLink'.
--
-- == What is on here
--
-- Calls that find, read or change a session, by job. The calls that take a
-- @Server@ contact tmux; the rest read values you already hold.
--
-- __Get the sessions in a snapshot.__ Capture a snapshot through a Server,
-- then list its sessions in ID order or start a query from them.
--
-- * From a Server: 'LibTmux.Server.capture'
-- * From a snapshot: 'LibTmux.Snapshot.sessions'
-- * As a query source: 'LibTmux.Query.sessions'
--
-- __Find a session by reference or ID.__ A lookup reads the snapshot you pass
-- and returns a lookup error for a missing or foreign reference. An ID selects
-- whichever session holds it in that snapshot, with no continuity with an
-- earlier Server.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Snapshot.lookupSession', 'LibTmux.Snapshot.lookupSessionId',
-- t'SessionRef', t'LookupError'
--
-- __Parse and print session IDs.__ Parsing and rendering are pure. An ID
-- carries no endpoint or liveness evidence.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Id.parseSessionId', 'LibTmux.Id.renderSessionId',
-- 'LibTmux.Id.sessionIdValue', 'LibTmux.Snapshot.sessionId', t'SessionId'
--
-- __Read a session's fields.__ Use record dot on the value, or a field token
-- in a query. Field tokens describe captured values and never contact tmux.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.sessionId', 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.sessionName',
-- 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.sessionAttached', 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.sessionGroup'
--
-- __Follow a session to its windows and clients, or back.__ A session reaches
-- its windows through links, and one window can be linked more than once. A
-- window link and a client attachment each name a session; resolve it in a
-- query.
--
-- * From a snapshot: 'LibTmux.Snapshot.linksForSession'
-- * From a session in a query: 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.sessionWindowLinks',
--   'LibTmux.Query.Fields.sessionClients'
-- * Test its links or clients: 'LibTmux.Query.some', 'LibTmux.Query.every',
--   'LibTmux.Query.none'
-- * From a window link: 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.linkSessionId',
--   'LibTmux.Query.Fields.linkSession'
-- * From a client attachment: 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.clientAttachmentSessionId',
--   'LibTmux.Query.Fields.clientAttachmentSession'
-- * Resolve the session: 'LibTmux.Query.related'
--
-- __Select sessions with a query.__ Match the name by equality or an exact
-- substring and the attached count by a threshold, then run the query on a
-- snapshot you hold or fetch a fresh one. @exactlyOne@ turns a result into one
-- session or an error.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Query.sessions', 'LibTmux.Query.matching', 'LibTmux.Query.eq',
-- 'LibTmux.Query.contains', 'LibTmux.Query.ge', 'LibTmux.Query.runQuery',
-- 'LibTmux.Query.fetch', 'LibTmux.Query.exactlyOne'
--
-- __Create a session.__ Creation returns the references tmux printed, not an
-- observed session. Capture again to see the new session. A failed creation
-- can leave a receipt in its recovery, and a missing receipt does not mean no
-- session exists.
--
-- * Create: 'LibTmux.Server.createSession', 'LibTmux.Server.createSessionWith'
-- * Describe: 'LibTmux.Creation.defaultSessionOptions',
--   t'LibTmux.Creation.SessionOptions', t'LibTmux.Creation.CreatedSession'
-- * After a failure: 'LibTmux.Recovery.creationReceipt'
--
-- __Rename a session.__ The name is literal text, and snapshots you already
-- hold keep the old name. A reference from another Server or an offline
-- fixture is refused before the command runs. The @With@ variant takes a
-- deadline.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Server.renameSession', 'LibTmux.Server.renameSessionWith'
--
-- __Add a window to a session.__ A placement names the session and where the
-- window goes: the next free index or a slot. The result holds the references
-- tmux printed, so capture again to observe the window.
--
-- * Create: 'LibTmux.Server.createWindow', 'LibTmux.Server.createWindowWith'
-- * Place: t'LibTmux.Creation.WindowPlacement', t'LibTmux.Creation.WindowSlot'
--
-- __Remove a session.__ A window that another session links survives. tmux may
-- exit when its last session closes, so observe the daemon separately.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Server.killSession', 'LibTmux.Server.killSessionWith'
--
-- __Change which windows a session links.__ A slot names the session and the
-- index of one link. Select a link, link a window into a vacant slot, or remove
-- one link; tmux refuses to remove a window's last link, and session groups can
-- propagate links.
--
-- * Select: 'LibTmux.Server.selectWindowLink',
--   'LibTmux.Server.selectWindowLinkWith'
-- * Link: 'LibTmux.Server.linkWindow', 'LibTmux.Server.linkWindowWith'
-- * Unlink: 'LibTmux.Server.unlinkWindow', 'LibTmux.Server.unlinkWindowWith'
-- * Slot: t'LibTmux.Creation.WindowSlot'
--
-- __Build a session offline.__ Fixture references belong to a named offline
-- origin, never to a live Server. Validation checks a fixture before it
-- becomes a snapshot.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Snapshot.Fixture.sessionRef',
-- 'LibTmux.Snapshot.Fixture.validateFixture',
-- t'LibTmux.Snapshot.Fixture.Fixture'
data Session = Session
  { ref :: !SessionRef -- ^ Target identity in the observation's generation.
  , name :: !Text -- ^ Session name as reported and decoded by tmux.
  , attached :: !Integer -- ^ Nonnegative reported count, independent of the captured client listing.
  , group :: !(Maybe TmuxText) -- ^ Reported session-group label; absent when this session is ungrouped.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData Session where
  rnf (Session ref name attached group) = rnf (ref, name, attached, group)

-- | Detached physical window, independent of its session and index appearances.
--
-- == What is on here
--
-- Calls that find, read or change a window, by job. The calls that take a
-- @Server@ contact tmux; the rest read values you already hold.
--
-- __Get the windows in a snapshot.__ A physical window is listed once, however
-- many sessions link it; the link lists show every appearance instead.
--
-- * From a Server: 'LibTmux.Server.capture'
-- * From a snapshot: 'LibTmux.Snapshot.windows',
--   'LibTmux.Snapshot.windowLinks'
-- * As a query source: 'LibTmux.Query.windows', 'LibTmux.Query.windowLinks'
--
-- __Find a window by reference or ID.__ A lookup reads the snapshot you pass
-- and returns a lookup error for a missing or foreign reference. An ID selects
-- whichever window holds it in that snapshot.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Snapshot.lookupWindow', 'LibTmux.Snapshot.lookupWindowId',
-- t'WindowRef', t'LookupError'
--
-- __Parse and print window IDs.__ Parsing and rendering are pure. An ID is
-- independent of a session's link index.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Id.parseWindowId', 'LibTmux.Id.renderWindowId',
-- 'LibTmux.Id.windowIdValue', 'LibTmux.Snapshot.windowId', t'WindowId'
--
-- __Read a window's fields.__ Use record dot on the value, or a field token in
-- a query. The name keeps the bytes tmux reports, because older supported
-- releases can retain names that are not valid UTF-8; decode it as UTF-8 when
-- you need text.
--
-- * Field tokens: 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.windowId', 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.windowName',
--   'LibTmux.Query.Fields.windowWidth', 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.windowHeight',
--   'LibTmux.Query.Fields.windowLayout', 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.windowZoomed'
-- * The name as bytes: t'TmuxText', 'LibTmux.Snapshot.labelText',
--   'LibTmux.Snapshot.labelBytes', 'LibTmux.Snapshot.labelFromBytes'
--
-- __Follow a window to its panes and links.__ Panes come in pane-index order.
-- One window can have several links, and its name and pane set are shared
-- across them.
--
-- * From a snapshot: 'LibTmux.Snapshot.panesForWindow'
-- * From a window in a query: 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.windowPanes',
--   'LibTmux.Query.Fields.windowLinks'
-- * Test its panes or links: 'LibTmux.Query.some', 'LibTmux.Query.every',
--   'LibTmux.Query.none'
-- * From a window link: 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.linkPanes'
--
-- __Reach a window from a link, a pane or a client.__ Each names one window;
-- resolve it in a query.
--
-- * From a window link: 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.linkWindowId',
--   'LibTmux.Query.Fields.linkWindow'
-- * From a pane: 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneWindowId', 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneWindow'
-- * From a client attachment: 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.clientAttachmentWindowId',
--   'LibTmux.Query.Fields.clientAttachmentWindow'
-- * Resolve the window: 'LibTmux.Query.related'
--
-- __Read where a window sits in a session.__ A window's index belongs to a
-- link in one session, not to the window, and reindexing can change it.
--
-- * Index type: t'WindowIndex', 'LibTmux.Value.mkWindowIndex',
--   'LibTmux.Value.windowIndexValue'
-- * Field tokens: 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.linkIndex',
--   'LibTmux.Query.Fields.clientAttachmentWindowIndex'
-- * Thresholds: 'LibTmux.Query.windowIndexAtLeast',
--   'LibTmux.Query.windowIndexAtMost'
--
-- __Select windows with a query.__ Compare sizes with a dimension threshold.
-- Names are bytes, so match them with exact equality rather than a substring.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Query.windows', 'LibTmux.Query.matching', 'LibTmux.Query.eq',
-- 'LibTmux.Query.dimensionAtLeast', 'LibTmux.Query.dimensionAtMost',
-- 'LibTmux.Query.runQuery', 'LibTmux.Query.fetch'
--
-- __Create a window.__ A placement says where it goes, and the options set a
-- label, a directory, an environment, whether to select it and what to do with
-- an occupied slot, which is refused by default. The result holds the
-- references tmux printed, so capture again to observe the window.
--
-- * Create: 'LibTmux.Server.createWindow', 'LibTmux.Server.createWindowWith'
-- * Place: t'LibTmux.Creation.WindowPlacement', t'LibTmux.Creation.WindowSlot',
--   t'LibTmux.Creation.WindowCollision'
-- * Options: t'LibTmux.Creation.WindowOptions',
--   'LibTmux.Creation.defaultWindowOptions'
-- * Result: t'LibTmux.Creation.CreatedWindow'
--
-- __Get the window a new session starts with.__ Creating a session returns
-- the reference and link index of its first window. Capture again to observe
-- the window.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Server.createSession', 'LibTmux.Server.createSessionWith',
-- t'LibTmux.Creation.CreatedSession'
--
-- __Rename a window.__ One rename changes the physical window across all its
-- session links. The label keeps its bytes, and tmux may reject names its
-- release does not accept. A reference from another Server or an offline
-- fixture is refused before the command runs.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Server.renameWindow', 'LibTmux.Server.renameWindowWith'
--
-- __Link a window into another slot, or remove a link.__ A slot names a session
-- and a link index. Linking puts the window in a vacant slot; existing links
-- remain and the new link starts unselected. tmux refuses to remove a window's
-- last link, and session groups can propagate either change.
--
-- * Link: 'LibTmux.Server.linkWindow', 'LibTmux.Server.linkWindowWith'
-- * Unlink: 'LibTmux.Server.unlinkWindow', 'LibTmux.Server.unlinkWindowWith'
-- * Slot: t'LibTmux.Creation.WindowSlot'
--
-- __Select a window link.__ Selection works on a link, so it can pick one of
-- several links to the same physical window. Capture again to observe it.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Server.selectWindowLink', 'LibTmux.Server.selectWindowLinkWith',
-- t'LibTmux.Creation.WindowSlot'
--
-- __Arrange a window's panes with a named layout.__ Every link to the window
-- sees the new layout, and tmux can unzoom the window. Capture again to observe
-- the pane geometry.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Server.selectLayout', 'LibTmux.Server.selectLayoutWith',
-- t'LibTmux.Server.NamedLayout'
--
-- __Remove a window.__ One removal closes the physical window across all its
-- links, and tmux closes a session left without windows.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Server.killWindow', 'LibTmux.Server.killWindowWith'
--
-- __Build a window offline.__ Fixture references belong to a named offline
-- origin, never to a live Server. Validation checks a fixture before it
-- becomes a snapshot.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Snapshot.Fixture.windowRef',
-- 'LibTmux.Snapshot.Fixture.validateFixture',
-- t'LibTmux.Snapshot.Fixture.Fixture'
data Window = Window
  { ref :: !WindowRef -- ^ Shared identity across this snapshot's window links.
  , name :: !TmuxText -- ^ Reported bytes, including non-text names on older tmux.
  , width :: !Dimension -- ^ Positive terminal width in cells.
  , height :: !Dimension -- ^ Positive terminal height in cells.
  , layout :: !Text -- ^ Native unzoomed layout encoding, opaque and release-dependent.
  , zoomed :: !Bool -- ^ Whether a pane currently occupies this window through zoom.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData Window where
  rnf (Window ref name width height layout zoomed) = rnf (ref, name, width, height, layout, zoomed)

-- | Detached physical pane. Its window can appear in several session contexts;
-- t'PaneOccurrence' preserves an appearance without duplicating physical identity.
--
-- == What is on here
--
-- Calls that find, read or change a pane, by job. The calls that take a
-- @Server@ contact tmux; the rest read values you already hold.
--
-- __Get the panes in a snapshot.__ The pane lists show each physical pane
-- once; the occurrence lists keep every appearance, including repeats through
-- several links.
--
-- * From a Server: 'LibTmux.Server.capture'
-- * From a snapshot: 'LibTmux.Snapshot.panes',
--   'LibTmux.Snapshot.paneOccurrences'
-- * As a query source: 'LibTmux.Query.panes', 'LibTmux.Query.paneOccurrences'
--
-- __Find a pane by reference or ID.__ A lookup reads the snapshot you pass and
-- returns a lookup error for a missing or foreign reference. An ID selects
-- whichever pane holds it in that snapshot.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Snapshot.lookupPane', 'LibTmux.Snapshot.lookupPaneId', t'PaneRef',
-- t'LookupError'
--
-- __Parse and print pane IDs.__ Parsing and rendering are pure. An ID carries
-- no endpoint or liveness evidence.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Id.parsePaneId', 'LibTmux.Id.renderPaneId',
-- 'LibTmux.Id.paneIdValue', 'LibTmux.Snapshot.paneId', t'PaneId'
--
-- __Read a pane's fields.__ Use record dot on the value, or a field token in a
-- query. The title is UTF-8 text; the command and path keep the POSIX bytes
-- from the endpoint.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneId', 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneWindowId',
-- 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneIndex', 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneWidth',
-- 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneHeight', 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneActive',
-- 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneDead', 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneTitle',
-- 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneCurrentCommand', 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneCurrentPath',
-- 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneCursorX', 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneCursorY',
-- 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneModeCount', 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneMode'
--
-- __Follow a pane to its window and back.__ A window's panes come in
-- pane-index order. Resolve a pane's window in a query.
--
-- * From a pane in a query: 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.paneWindow'
-- * Resolve the window: 'LibTmux.Query.related'
-- * From a snapshot: 'LibTmux.Snapshot.panesForWindow'
-- * From a window in a query: 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.windowPanes'
-- * From a window link: 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.linkPanes'
-- * Test a window's panes: 'LibTmux.Query.some', 'LibTmux.Query.every',
--   'LibTmux.Query.none'
--
-- __Keep the context a pane appears in.__ An occurrence pairs a physical pane
-- with one window link, and a client attachment selects a pane in its actual
-- session and index.
--
-- * From a pane occurrence: 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.occurrencePane',
--   'LibTmux.Query.Fields.occurrenceLink'
-- * From a client attachment: 'LibTmux.Query.Fields.clientAttachmentPaneId',
--   'LibTmux.Query.Fields.clientAttachmentPane'
-- * Occurrence type: t'PaneOccurrence'
--
-- __Select panes with a query.__ Compare sizes and indices with thresholds,
-- and match the title by equality or an exact substring.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Query.panes', 'LibTmux.Query.matching', 'LibTmux.Query.eq',
-- 'LibTmux.Query.contains', 'LibTmux.Query.dimensionAtLeast',
-- 'LibTmux.Query.dimensionAtMost', 'LibTmux.Query.paneIndexAtLeast',
-- 'LibTmux.Query.paneIndexAtMost', 'LibTmux.Query.runQuery',
-- 'LibTmux.Query.fetch'
--
-- __Validate a pane index or size.__ Construction checks the mathematical
-- domain, and the accessors return integers.
--
-- * Pane index: t'PaneIndex', 'LibTmux.Value.mkPaneIndex',
--   'LibTmux.Value.paneIndexValue'
-- * Size: t'Dimension', 'LibTmux.Value.mkDimension',
--   'LibTmux.Value.dimensionValue'
--
-- __Get the first pane of a new session or window.__ Creating one returns the
-- reference of its first pane. Capture again to observe the pane.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Server.createSession', 'LibTmux.Server.createSessionWith',
-- 'LibTmux.Server.createWindow', 'LibTmux.Server.createWindowWith',
-- t'LibTmux.Creation.CreatedEntities'
--
-- __Split a pane.__ Name the pane and the session slot that holds its window,
-- then choose a direction and a size. The slot must hold that pane's window
-- when tmux runs the command, and the size is a request that tmux can clamp or
-- refuse. The result records the new pane and the context it was split in.
--
-- * Split: 'LibTmux.Server.splitPane', 'LibTmux.Server.splitPaneWith'
-- * Options: t'LibTmux.Creation.SplitOptions',
--   'LibTmux.Creation.defaultSplitOptions', t'LibTmux.Creation.SplitDirection',
--   t'LibTmux.Creation.SplitSize'
-- * Slot and result: t'LibTmux.Creation.WindowSlot',
--   t'LibTmux.Creation.CreatedPane'
--
-- __Select a pane.__ Name the pane and the window link that holds it. tmux
-- rejects a pane that no longer belongs to that link's current window.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Server.selectExactPane', 'LibTmux.Server.selectExactPaneWith',
-- t'LibTmux.Creation.WindowSlot'
--
-- __Arrange the panes of a window.__ A named layout applies to the physical
-- window at a slot and changes the geometry of its panes. Capture again to
-- observe the result.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Server.selectLayout', 'LibTmux.Server.selectLayoutWith',
-- t'LibTmux.Server.NamedLayout', t'LibTmux.Creation.WindowSlot'
--
-- __Set a pane's title.__ The title is literal text, and the pane's
-- application can replace it later. A reference from another Server or an
-- offline fixture is refused before the command runs.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Server.setPaneTitle', 'LibTmux.Server.setPaneTitleWith'
--
-- __Send input to a pane.__ Send literal text, or named tmux keys such as
-- @Enter@ in order. Nothing appends Enter, and success confirms that tmux
-- processed the request, not that the application responded. An invalid key
-- name raises an error before any key is typed.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Server.sendKeys', 'LibTmux.Server.sendKeysWith',
-- t'LibTmux.Server.PaneInput'
--
-- __Read a pane's text.__ Capture the visible rows or a range, as plain text or
-- with ANSI styling, within a byte limit. The result is a detached observation,
-- and reading its text contacts no daemon.
--
-- * Capture: 'LibTmux.Server.capturePane'
-- * Options: t'LibTmux.Pane.PaneCaptureOptions',
--   'LibTmux.Pane.defaultPaneCapture', t'LibTmux.Pane.PaneRows',
--   t'LibTmux.Pane.PaneRendering'
-- * Read: t'LibTmux.Server.PaneText', 'LibTmux.Server.paneText'
--
-- __Wait for text in a pane.__ Poll one exact pane for a case-sensitive
-- substring under a single deadline of at most ten seconds. Presence can match
-- text already on screen; a fresh match compares with a capture taken before
-- the input and ignores that text. A timeout or the pane's exit still returns
-- the last capture when one completed.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Server.waitForText', t'LibTmux.Server.PaneWaitOptions',
-- 'LibTmux.Server.defaultPaneWait', t'LibTmux.Server.PaneMatch',
-- t'LibTmux.Server.PaneWaitResult'
--
-- __Remove a pane.__ Removing the last pane also closes its window. Success
-- confirms that tmux removed the pane, so observe its processes' exit
-- separately.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Server.killPane', 'LibTmux.Server.killPaneWith'
--
-- __Build a pane offline.__ Fixture references belong to a named offline
-- origin, never to a live Server. Validation checks a fixture before it
-- becomes a snapshot.
--
-- 'LibTmux.Snapshot.Fixture.paneRef',
-- 'LibTmux.Snapshot.Fixture.validateFixture',
-- t'LibTmux.Snapshot.Fixture.Fixture'
data Pane = Pane
  { ref :: !PaneRef -- ^ Pane identity in the observation's generation.
  , window :: !WindowRef -- ^ Containing physical window, resolved against a snapshot.
  , index :: !PaneIndex -- ^ Nonnegative pane index within that window.
  , width :: !Dimension -- ^ Positive terminal width in cells.
  , height :: !Dimension -- ^ Positive terminal height in cells.
  , active :: !Bool -- ^ The window's active pane, rather than a separate client focus.
  , dead :: !Bool -- ^ Whether tmux reports the pane process as dead.
  , title :: !Text -- ^ Valid UTF-8 pane title reported by tmux.
  , currentCommand :: !PosixString -- ^ Reported process name; tmux may normalize it.
  , currentPath :: !PosixPath -- ^ Endpoint data, without local path interpretation.
  , cursorX :: !Integer -- ^ Zero-based base-screen column; may equal width at pending wrap.
  , cursorY :: !Integer -- ^ Zero-based base-screen row, independent of a mode cursor.
  , modeCount :: !Integer -- ^ Native pane mode-stack depth, rather than a Boolean.
  , mode :: !(Maybe Text) -- ^ Name of the current mode; absent when no mode is active.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData Pane where
  rnf (Pane ref window index width height active dead title command path x y count mode) =
    rnf ((ref, window, index, width, height), (active, dead, title, command, path), (x, y, count, mode))

-- | One observed session/index/window binding. Indices are reusable positions;
-- this value describes captured context. The same window may appear repeatedly.
data WindowLink = WindowLink
  { session :: !SessionRef -- ^ Session containing this appearance.
  , index :: !WindowIndex -- ^ Position of this link within the session.
  , window :: !WindowRef -- ^ Physical window shared by its appearances.
  , active :: !Bool -- ^ Whether this is the session's selected window link.
  , flags :: !Text -- ^ Native window_flags for this link, including tmux's doubled @#@ escaping.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData WindowLink where
  rnf (WindowLink session index window active flags) = rnf (session, index, window, active, flags)

-- | A physical pane together with one contextual window appearance.
data PaneOccurrence = PaneOccurrence
  { pane :: !Pane -- ^ Captured physical pane value.
  , link :: !WindowLink -- ^ Session and index context through which it appears.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData PaneOccurrence where
  rnf (PaneOccurrence pane link) = rnf (pane, link)

-- | Reported daemon metadata within one adopted generation. PID and start
-- time are observations; they do not grant signal authority or durable identity.
data ServerInfo = ServerInfo
  { generation :: !Generation -- ^ Connection identity shared by all references in this snapshot.
  , pid :: !Integer -- ^ Positive daemon process ID reported by tmux.
  , startedAt :: !Integer -- ^ Daemon start time in whole seconds since the Unix epoch.
  , version :: !Version.TmuxVersion -- ^ Release admitted by "LibTmux.Version".
  , socketPath :: !PosixPath -- ^ Reported endpoint path, preserved as POSIX bytes.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData ServerInfo where
  rnf (ServerInfo generation pid startedAt version socketPath) = rnf generation
    `seq` rnf pid `seq` rnf startedAt `seq` rnf (Version.renderVersion version) `seq` rnf socketPath

-- | An attachment contains this capture's values. It never resolves a retained
-- client name against a later capture. The pane is the session window's global
-- active pane, not an independent client focus; its link retains session context.
data ClientAttachment = ClientAttachment
  { session :: !Session -- ^ Captured attachment session.
  , window :: !Window -- ^ Captured physical selected window.
  , pane :: !PaneOccurrence -- ^ Selected pane with its session/window-link context.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData ClientAttachment where
  rnf (ClientAttachment session window pane) = rnf (session, window, pane)

-- | A detached client observation, not an operational connection or live ref.
-- The live profile lists attached clients; an offline value may be unattached.
data Client = Client
  { name :: !PosixString -- ^ Reported client-name bytes; names may be reused.
  , pid :: !Integer -- ^ Reported positive client process ID.
  , tty :: !(Maybe PosixPath) -- ^ Reported terminal path, when present.
  , attachment :: !(Maybe ClientAttachment) -- ^ Attachment values resolved within this capture.
  , width :: !Integer -- ^ Reported unsigned tty width in cells; may be zero for a control client.
  , height :: !(Maybe Integer) -- ^ Reported tty height only when tmux has started its terminal.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData Client where
  rnf (Client name pid tty attachment width height) = rnf (name, pid, tty, attachment, width, height)

-- Required native context from the attached-only listing, before graph lookup.
data ClientInput = ClientInput
  { name :: !PosixString
  , pid :: !Integer
  , tty :: !(Maybe PosixPath)
  , session :: !SessionId
  , window :: !WindowId
  , index :: !WindowIndex
  , pane :: !PaneId
  , width :: !Integer
  , height :: !(Maybe Integer)
  }

-- | Validated metadata, physical graph and attached-client observations.
-- Construction checks every join and forces owned values. List processing
-- and indexed lookup remain pure after the operational Server closes.
data Snapshot = Snapshot !ServerInfo !EntityGraph ![Client] !(Maybe CaptureInterval)
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData Snapshot where
  rnf (Snapshot info graph rows interval) = rnf info `seq` rnf graph `seq` rnf rows `seq` rnf interval

-- | Daemon metadata captured with this graph.
serverInfo :: Snapshot -> ServerInfo
serverInfo (Snapshot info _ _ _) = info

entities :: Snapshot -> EntityGraph
entities (Snapshot _ graph _ _) = graph

-- | Captured attached clients in reported-name and PID order. Names may repeat.
clients :: Snapshot -> [Client]
clients (Snapshot _ _ rows _) = rows

-- | Monotonic process-clock bounds around acquisition. These values describe
-- an interval and do not promise an atomic observation or a wall-clock epoch.
data CaptureInterval = CaptureInterval
  { startedNanoseconds :: !Word64 -- ^ Monotonic time sampled before acquisition.
  , finishedNanoseconds :: !Word64 -- ^ Monotonic time after decoding and forcing.
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData CaptureInterval where
  rnf (CaptureInterval started finished) = rnf started `seq` rnf finished

-- | Acquisition bounds attached to a live capture. An unstamped decoded
-- profile stays private; an offline fixture has no external capture interval.
captureInterval :: Snapshot -> Maybe CaptureInterval
captureInterval (Snapshot _ _ _ interval) = interval

stampSnapshot :: Word64 -> Word64 -> Snapshot -> Either GraphError Snapshot
stampSnapshot started finished (Snapshot info graph rows _)
  | started > finished = Left InvalidCaptureInterval
  | otherwise =
      let !interval = CaptureInterval started finished
      in Right (Snapshot info graph rows (Just interval))

data EntityGraph = EntityGraph
  { generation :: !Generation
  , sessions :: !(Map SessionRef Session)
  , windows :: !(Map WindowRef Window)
  , panes :: !(Map PaneRef Pane)
  , links :: !(Map (SessionRef, WindowIndex) WindowLink)
  , sessionLinks :: !(Map SessionRef [WindowLink])
  , windowPanes :: !(Map WindowRef [Pane])
  }
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)
instance NFData EntityGraph where
  rnf graph = rnf graph.generation `seq` rnf graph.sessions `seq`
    rnf graph.windows `seq` rnf graph.panes `seq` rnf graph.links `seq`
    rnf graph.sessionLinks `seq` rnf graph.windowPanes

-- | A reference that cannot resolve in the supplied immutable snapshot.
-- Missing entities are distinct from a successfully observed empty relation.
data LookupError
  = ForeignGeneration -- ^ The reference belongs to another connection generation.
  | MissingSession !SessionRef -- ^ No session with this identity was captured.
  | MissingWindow !WindowRef -- ^ No physical window with this identity was captured.
  | MissingPane !PaneRef -- ^ No physical pane with this identity was captured.
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)

-- | Invalid entity or server data observed while assembling a snapshot.
data GraphError
  = InvalidGeneration
  | InvalidReference !LookupError
  | ConflictingSession !SessionRef
  | ConflictingWindow !WindowRef
  | ConflictingPane !PaneRef
  | DuplicateWindowSlot !SessionRef !WindowIndex
  | DuplicatePaneIndex !WindowRef !PaneIndex
  | InvalidAttachedCount !SessionRef !Integer
  | InvalidSessionSelection !SessionRef !Int
  | InvalidPaneSelection !WindowRef !Int
  | UnlinkedWindow !WindowRef
  | InvalidServerInfo
  | InvalidClientMetadata
  | InvalidPaneMetadata !PaneRef
  | MissingClientLink !SessionRef !WindowIndex
  | ChangedClientAttachment
  | InvalidCaptureInterval
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)

assembleEntityGraph
  :: Generation -> [Session] -> [Window] -> [Pane] -> [WindowLink]
  -> Either GraphError EntityGraph
assembleEntityGraph generation sessionRows windowRows paneRows linkRows = do
  let valid = case generation of
        Generation (EndpointIdentity device inode) token ->
          device >= 0 && inode >= 0 && Bytes.length token == 32
        FixtureGeneration _ -> True
  unless valid (Left InvalidGeneration)
  mapM_ checkSession sessionRows
  mapM_ (checkWindowRef . (.ref)) windowRows
  mapM_ checkPane paneRows
  mapM_ checkLink linkRows
  sessions <- uniqueBy (.ref) ConflictingSession sessionRows
  windows <- uniqueBy (.ref) ConflictingWindow windowRows
  panes <- uniqueBy (.ref) ConflictingPane paneRows
  links <- foldM insertLink Map.empty linkRows
  let sessionLinks = Map.map (sortOn (\row -> (row.index, row.window))) $
        Map.fromListWith (<>) [(row.session, [row]) | row <- Map.elems links]
      windowPanes = Map.map (sortOn (\row -> (row.index, row.ref))) $
        Map.fromListWith (<>) [(row.window, [row]) | row <- Map.elems panes]
      graph = EntityGraph {generation, sessions, windows, panes, links, sessionLinks, windowPanes}
      linkedWindows = Set.fromList [row.window | row <- Map.elems links]
  mapM_ (\row -> first InvalidReference
    (lookupSession graph row.session >> lookupWindow graph row.window)) (Map.elems links)
  mapM_ (\row -> first InvalidReference (lookupWindow graph row.window)) (Map.elems panes)
  void (foldM checkPaneIndex Set.empty (Map.elems panes))
  mapM_ (checkSessionSelection sessionLinks) (Map.keys sessions)
  mapM_ (checkWindowSelection linkedWindows windowPanes) (Map.keys windows)
  graph `deepseq` Right graph
  where
    checkGeneration actual = unless (actual == generation) (Left (InvalidReference ForeignGeneration))
    checkSessionRef (SessionRef actual _) = checkGeneration actual
    checkWindowRef (WindowRef actual _) = checkGeneration actual
    checkSession row = do
      checkSessionRef row.ref
      when (row.attached < 0) (Left (InvalidAttachedCount row.ref row.attached))
    checkPane row = do
      let PaneRef actual _ = row.ref
      checkGeneration actual
      checkWindowRef row.window
      unless (all unsigned [row.cursorX, row.cursorY, row.modeCount]) (Left (InvalidPaneMetadata row.ref))
    unsigned value = value >= 0 && value <= 4294967295
    checkLink row = checkSessionRef row.session >> checkWindowRef row.window
    insertLink rows row
      | Map.member (row.session, row.index) rows = Left (DuplicateWindowSlot row.session row.index)
      | otherwise = Right (Map.insert (row.session, row.index) row rows)
    checkPaneIndex seen row
      | Set.member (row.window, row.index) seen = Left (DuplicatePaneIndex row.window row.index)
      | otherwise = Right (Set.insert (row.window, row.index) seen)
    checkSessionSelection rows ref =
      let selected = length (filter (.active) (Map.findWithDefault [] ref rows))
      in unless (selected == 1) (Left (InvalidSessionSelection ref selected))
    checkWindowSelection linked rows ref = do
      unless (Set.member ref linked) (Left (UnlinkedWindow ref))
      let selected = length (filter (.active) (Map.findWithDefault [] ref rows))
      unless (selected == 1) (Left (InvalidPaneSelection ref selected))

uniqueBy :: (Ord key, Eq row) => (row -> key) -> (key -> GraphError) -> [row] -> Either GraphError (Map key row)
uniqueBy key conflict = foldM insert Map.empty
  where
    insert rows row = case Map.lookup (key row) rows of
      Nothing -> Right (Map.insert (key row) row rows)
      Just old | old == row -> Right rows
      Just _ -> Left (conflict (key row))

graphSessions :: EntityGraph -> [Session]
graphSessions graph = Map.elems graph.sessions

graphWindows :: EntityGraph -> [Window]
graphWindows graph = Map.elems graph.windows

graphPanes :: EntityGraph -> [Pane]
graphPanes graph = Map.elems graph.panes

graphLinks :: EntityGraph -> [WindowLink]
graphLinks graph = Map.elems graph.links

graphOccurrences :: EntityGraph -> [PaneOccurrence]
graphOccurrences graph =
  [ PaneOccurrence pane link
  | link <- graphLinks graph
  , pane <- Map.findWithDefault [] link.window graph.windowPanes
  ]

lookupSession :: EntityGraph -> SessionRef -> Either LookupError Session
lookupSession graph ref@(SessionRef generation _)
  | generation /= graph.generation = Left ForeignGeneration
  | otherwise = maybe (Left (MissingSession ref)) Right (Map.lookup ref graph.sessions)

lookupWindow :: EntityGraph -> WindowRef -> Either LookupError Window
lookupWindow graph ref@(WindowRef generation _)
  | generation /= graph.generation = Left ForeignGeneration
  | otherwise = maybe (Left (MissingWindow ref)) Right (Map.lookup ref graph.windows)

lookupPane :: EntityGraph -> PaneRef -> Either LookupError Pane
lookupPane graph ref@(PaneRef generation _)
  | generation /= graph.generation = Left ForeignGeneration
  | otherwise = maybe (Left (MissingPane ref)) Right (Map.lookup ref graph.panes)

linksForSession :: EntityGraph -> SessionRef -> Either LookupError [WindowLink]
linksForSession graph ref = do
  _ <- lookupSession graph ref
  pure (Map.findWithDefault [] ref graph.sessionLinks)

panesForWindow :: EntityGraph -> WindowRef -> Either LookupError [Pane]
panesForWindow graph ref = do
  _ <- lookupWindow graph ref
  pure (Map.findWithDefault [] ref graph.windowPanes)

-- | Resolve the attached listing against its captured graph. A detached Client
-- keeps the resolved observations even after later selection or name reuse.
-- Session attached counts and listing cardinality have different tmux rules;
-- neither is reconstructed from the other.
assembleSnapshot :: ServerInfo -> EntityGraph -> [ClientInput] -> Either GraphError Snapshot
assembleSnapshot info graph inputs = do
  unless (info.generation == graph.generation) (Left (InvalidReference ForeignGeneration))
  unless (positivePid info.pid && info.startedAt >= 0 && info.startedAt <= 9223372036854775807
    && validString info.socketPath && not (Os.null info.socketPath)
    && either (const False) (const True) (Version.requireSupported info.version)) (Left InvalidServerInfo)
  rows <- mapM hydrate inputs
  let snapshot = Snapshot info graph (sortOn (\row -> (row.name, row.pid)) rows) Nothing
  snapshot `deepseq` Right snapshot
  where
    unsigned value = value >= 0 && value <= 4294967295
    positivePid value = value > 0 && value <= toInteger (maxBound @CInt)
    validString value = Os.length value <= 1048576 && not (any ((== '\NUL') . Os.toChar) (Os.unpack value))
    hydrate input = do
      unless (positivePid input.pid && validString input.name && not (Os.null input.name)
        && maybe True (\path -> validString path && not (Os.null path)) input.tty
        && unsigned input.width && maybe True unsigned input.height) (Left InvalidClientMetadata)
      session <- first InvalidReference (lookupSession graph (SessionRef graph.generation input.session))
      window <- first InvalidReference (lookupWindow graph (WindowRef graph.generation input.window))
      pane <- first InvalidReference (lookupPane graph (PaneRef graph.generation input.pane))
      link <- maybe (Left (MissingClientLink session.ref input.index)) Right
        (Map.lookup (session.ref, input.index) graph.links)
      unless (link.window == window.ref && pane.window == window.ref && link.active && pane.active)
        (Left ChangedClientAttachment)
      let attachment = ClientAttachment session window (PaneOccurrence pane link)
      pure (Client input.name input.pid input.tty (Just attachment) input.width input.height)

-- | One synchronous mutation and its retained ownership. A deadline bounds
-- submission as well as waiting; recovery never dispatches the command again.
module LibTmux.Internal.Mutation
  ( performMutation, performRequest, performRequests, checkMutationReply
  , MutationRecovery, recoveryReceipt, inspectRecovery
  , resumeRecovery, awaitRecovery, detachRecovery
  ) where

import Control.Applicative ((<|>))
import Control.Concurrent.STM (STM, atomically, check)
import Control.Exception
  ( ExceptionWithContext (..), SomeException, catchNoPropagate, fromException
  , mask, onException, rethrowIO, throwIO, toException
  )
import Control.Exception.Annotation (ExceptionAnnotation)
import Control.Exception.Context qualified as Context
import Control.Monad (forM_, unless, when)
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import Data.IORef (newIORef, readIORef, writeIORef)
import Data.Maybe (listToMaybe)
import Data.Text qualified as Text
import Data.Word (Word64)
import GHC.Clock (getMonotonicTimeNSec)
import LibTmux.Internal.Command qualified as C
import LibTmux.Internal.Process qualified as P
import LibTmux.Internal.Process.Native qualified as N
import LibTmux.Internal.Runtime qualified as R
import LibTmux.Internal.Scope (TmuxException (..), ConfigurationProblem (..), TimeoutKind (..))
import System.Timeout (timeout)

-- | Reachable ownership for one failed or cancelled mutation. The receipt
-- retains metadata only; the Runtime retains outstanding native and logical
-- owners. Recovery never repeats the command. See "LibTmux.Server".
data MutationRecovery = MutationRecovery !R.Runtime !R.ServerHandle !R.ReadReceipt
instance Show MutationRecovery where
  showsPrec precedence (MutationRecovery _ _ receipt) =
    showParen (precedence > 10) (showString "MutationRecovery " . shows receipt)
instance ExceptionAnnotation MutationRecovery

recoveryReceipt :: MutationRecovery -> R.ReadReceipt
recoveryReceipt (MutationRecovery _ _ receipt) = receipt

inspectRecovery :: MutationRecovery -> STM R.ReadRecovery
inspectRecovery (MutationRecovery runtime server receipt) = R.inspectReceipt runtime server receipt

resumeRecovery :: MutationRecovery -> IO ()
resumeRecovery recovery@(MutationRecovery runtime server receipt) =
  recovering recovery (R.resumeReceipt runtime server receipt)

awaitRecovery :: MutationRecovery -> IO R.ReadRecovery
awaitRecovery recovery = recovering recovery $ atomically $ do
  observed <- inspectRecovery recovery
  check (not observed.workerOwned && not observed.nativeOwned)
  pure observed

detachRecovery :: MutationRecovery -> STM Bool
detachRecovery (MutationRecovery runtime server receipt) = R.detachReceipt runtime server receipt

performMutation :: P.Hooks -> Int -> R.Runtime -> R.ServerHandle -> ByteString -> C.Mutation -> IO ()
performMutation hooks duration runtime server executable mutation =
  performRequests duration runtime server $ \remainingTime await -> do
    case mutation of
      C.SendPaneKeys _ names -> do
        _ <- either (throwIO . R.InvalidCommandOperands) pure (C.compileMutation mutation)
        forM_ names $ \name -> do
          left <- remainingTime
          valid <- await (R.validateKeyWith hooks left runtime server executable name)
          unless valid (throwIO (InvalidMutationArgument (C.InvalidOperand "pane.key" "unknown tmux key")))
      _ -> pure ()
    left <- remainingTime
    await (R.mutateWith hooks left runtime server executable mutation) >>= checkMutationReply

checkMutationReply :: C.MutationReply -> IO ()
checkMutationReply = \case
  C.Applied -> pure ()
  C.Rejected diagnostic -> throwIO (MutationRejected diagnostic)
  C.AppliedWithErrors diagnostic -> throwIO (MutationAppliedWithErrors diagnostic)

-- | Share one absolute deadline and correlated owner across typed mutations.
-- Submission obtains remaining time after its own context acquisition; the
-- decoder runs within the same deadline. Recovery never resubmits the action.
performRequest
  :: Int -> R.Runtime -> R.ServerHandle
  -> (IO Int -> IO (R.Request value)) -> (value -> IO result) -> IO result
performRequest duration runtime server submit decode =
  performRequests duration runtime server $ \remainingTime await ->
    await (submit remainingTime) >>= decode

performRequests
  :: Int -> R.Runtime -> R.ServerHandle
  -> (IO Int -> (forall value. IO (R.Request value) -> IO value) -> IO result)
  -> IO result
performRequests duration runtime server run = mask $ \restore -> do
  when (duration < 1 || duration > 10000000)
    (throwIO (InvalidConfiguration (TimeoutOutOfRange MutationTimeout)))
  receipt <- newIORef Nothing
  let annotate (ExceptionWithContext context (problem :: SomeException)) = do
        current <- readIORef receipt
        let selected = current <|> listToMaybe (Context.getExceptionAnnotations @R.ReadReceipt context)
        case selected of
          Nothing -> rethrowIO (ExceptionWithContext context problem)
          Just value -> recovering (MutationRecovery runtime server value)
            (rethrowIO (ExceptionWithContext context problem))
      owned deadline = mask $ \unmask -> run (remaining deadline) $ \submit -> do
        request <- catchNoPropagate submit $
          \failure@(ExceptionWithContext context (problem :: SomeException)) -> do
            -- Timeout consumes its exception; retain correlation before conversion.
            writeIORef receipt (listToMaybe (Context.getExceptionAnnotations @R.ReadReceipt context))
            case (fromException @R.ReadError problem, fromException @N.Failure problem) of
              (Just (R.InvalidCommandOperands invalid), _) -> rethrowIO
                (ExceptionWithContext context (toException (InvalidMutationArgument invalid)))
              (_, Just (N.InvalidInput reason)) -> rethrowIO
                (ExceptionWithContext context (toException (InvalidConfiguration (InvalidLaunchConfiguration (Text.pack reason)))))
              _ -> rethrowIO failure
        let !current = R.readReceipt request
        writeIORef receipt (Just current)
        response <- unmask (R.awaitRead request) `onException` R.cancelRead runtime request
        case response of
          R.ReadValue value -> pure value
          R.ReadUnavailable _ (Just problem)
            | Just R.ReadExpired <- fromException problem -> throwIO MutationTimedOut
            | otherwise -> throwIO problem
          R.ReadUnavailable _ Nothing -> throwIO (OperationFailed (toException R.ReadCancelled))
      timed = do
        started <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
        let delta = fromIntegral duration * 1000
        when (started > maxBound - delta) (throwIO R.ReadClockOverflow)
        let deadline = started + delta
        completed <- timeout duration (owned deadline)
        case completed of
          Nothing -> throwIO MutationTimedOut
          Just value -> remaining deadline >> pure value
  catchNoPropagate (restore timed) annotate

remaining :: Word64 -> IO Int
remaining deadline = do
  now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
  when (now >= deadline) (throwIO MutationTimedOut)
  pure (fromIntegral ((deadline - now + 999) `div` 1000))

recovering :: MutationRecovery -> IO a -> IO a
recovering recovery action = catchNoPropagate action $
  \(ExceptionWithContext context (problem :: SomeException)) ->
    rethrowIO (ExceptionWithContext (Context.addExceptionAnnotation recovery context) problem)

-- | Application lifetime over the native Runtime. A separate pin and Runtime
-- keep incomplete cleanup usable after the borrowing Server scope has closed.
module LibTmux.Internal.Program
  ( Program, ProgramOptions (..), programOptions
  , ProgramExit (..), StartFailure (..), StartPhase (..)
  , ProgramScreen (..), ProgramResult (..), ProgramError (..)
  , ProgramRecovery, ProgramCleanupStatus (..), programRecoveries, programCleanupFailure
  , inspectProgramCleanup, resumeProgramCleanup
  , withOwnedProgram, runOwnedProgram
  , sendProgramInput, readProgramScreen, waitProgram, waitProgramFor, terminateProgram
  ) where

import Control.Concurrent (yield)
import Control.Concurrent.Async (race)
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Exception hiding (handle)
import Control.Exception.Annotation (ExceptionAnnotation)
import Control.Exception.Context (ExceptionContext)
import Control.Exception.Context qualified as Context
import Control.Monad (forM_, unless, void, when)
import Data.Bits ((.&.), shiftR)
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import Data.ByteString qualified as Bytes
import Data.ByteString.Char8 qualified as Ascii
import Data.IORef
import Data.List.NonEmpty (NonEmpty (..))

import Data.Text.Encoding qualified as Utf8
import Data.Time.Clock (NominalDiffTime)
import Foreign.C.Error (eSRCH)
